title: Fleur-de-Lis Stained Glass
description: An arched stained glass window featuring a large central blue and teal fleur-de-lis with intricate green scrollwork on both sides. The surrounding panes display a sky-blue and purple gradient with small floral motifs, set within an aged, weathered wooden frame with visible peeling paint and cracks.
